mapper.select: SELECT PRJ_NO , USER_ID , AUTHORITY_CODE , DELETE_DATE FROM PRJ_MEM
SELECT PRJ_NO , USER_ID , AUTHORITY_CODE , DELETE_DATE FROM PRJ_MEM WHERE PRJ_NO = #{prjNo} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT PRJ_NO as prjNo, USER_ID as userId, AUTHORITY_CODE as authorityCode, DELETE_DATE as deleteDate, USER_NAME as userName, USER_POSITION as userPosition FROM PRJ_MEM WHERE PRJ_NO = #{prjNo} AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL

SELECT PM.PRJ_NO as prjNo, PM.USER_ID as userId, PM.AUTHORITY_CODE as authorityCode, PM.DELETE_DATE as deleteDate FROM PRJ_MEM PM LEFT JOIN USERS U ON PM.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE PM.PRJ_NO = #{prjNo} AND PM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND PM.DELETE_DATE IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRJ_MEM ( PRJ_NO, USER_ID, AUTHORITY_CODE, DELETE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{prjNo}, #{userId}, #{authorityCode}, NULL )
